Siranta AI - Founder & Lead Engineer

A comprehensive ecosystem of zero-trust, bi-temporal agent memory and context aggregation tools.

The Problem

Large repositories create context stuffing for LLMs, and agent memories are opaque, mutable, and lack auditable timelines.

The Solution

Engineered a unified ecosystem featuring Kord (a pure Go CLI for rapid repo-to-XML flattening), Siranta Gateway (an embedded Triplestore and vector graph database for time-traveling audit logs), and Project Aura (zero-trust context routing).
